notes.en: Lam-alif. The combination of laam (ل) + alif (ا), written as a single fused glyph (لا). It is the Arabic word for 'no'. Because alif is a non-connector, this is the only way these two letters can appear together.
Lam-alif in its final form — used when the preceding letter connects into the laam (e.g. in 'فلا' = 'so no').
